Remember I’ve talked about Bill Hobbs, one of our life members who used to run for Thames Valley Harriers? We had a nice little comparison between my 1999 South of Thames Cross Country Champs team gold medal and Bill’s 1946 North of Thames Cross Country Champs team gold medal.

Thames Valley Harrier Bill Hobbs emigrated to New Zealand in 1957 and one of the first things he did on arrival was join Olympic. Now in 2007 his club were going to hold a special race to commemorate his long membership.
